name: codegraph
description: Inject the official CodeGraph prompt at session start (only when a `.codegraph/` directory exists) and expose all 20 codegraph CLI commands as slash commands for Codex/ZCode/Kimi/Claude Code. Pure Python stdlib.

interface.shortDescription: Discoverable codegraph — official prompt + all CLI commands
interface.longDescription: Injects the official CodeGraph prompt at SessionStart (only when `.codegraph/` exists). Exposes all 20 codegraph CLI commands as slash commands. Pure Python stdlib.
defaultPrompt: Index this repository with /codegraph-init so I can answer code questions via CodeGraph
Find callers of the function I just changed
Show me what would be affected if I change <symbol>
Run /codegraph-status so I can see if the index is stale
defaultPromptZhCn: 用 /codegraph-init 索引此仓库，我就能通过 CodeGraph 回答代码问题
找出我刚改的那个函数的所有调用方
看看如果改 <symbol> 会影响哪些代码
跑一下 /codegraph-status，看索引是否过期
